correctness.rationale: The six normalized Mallows weights are exact, and the remote pair reversal is \(\operatorname{Bin}(n,p)\). Exact exponential tilting makes each adjacent majority mean 1/2+delta with delta>0, so Hoeffding bounds all adjacent failures inside the rare reversal. The opposite orientation is exponentially smaller by a factored strict polynomial inequality. A Stirling and geometric-ratio calculation proves the full odd-n binomial tail coefficient. The standalone standard-library checker passed 171 finite consistency assertions; it is auxiliary, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Condorcet cycles are a canonical aggregation pathology. The theorem supplies both an exact large-electorate decay rate including \(n^{-1/2}\) normalization and a strict directional selection law. The positive tilted-margin lemma makes the three-way event a rare one-pair reversal rather than a naive product of independent pairwise errors; this is a motivated benchmark for probabilistic preference models, not a routine rename or an arbitrary finite slice.
